scope: 198 existing grammar points in current TOPIK I/II 1-6 draft
purpose: Per-point source verification and sequencing provenance for future Korean educator review
WARNING: This is an unverified evidence TRACKER, not a claim that listed points have been checked against primary Korean references. Empty evidence and rationale fields are intentional.
policy: Numbers, counters, dates, time and question-word lexical sets will be taught in separate early vocabulary decks, not represented here as new grammar points.

trackingFields.evidence: Add exact authoritative source URL, form-specific entry or printed chapter/section locator; mark TOC vs full-entry inspection
trackingFields.whyAtThisStage: Provide prerequisite/frequency/skill reason; source label alone does not prove optimal sequence
trackingFields.nativeEducatorReview: Mark approved/needs-revision with reviewer feedback after educator review
